scripts.db:up: docker compose up -d db && node database/scripts/wait-db.mjs
scripts.db:migrate: npm run build:packages && node database/dist/src/cli.js migrate
scripts.db:seed: npm run build:packages && node database/dist/src/cli.js reset
scripts.dev: npm run build:packages && concurrently -k -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @meduza/api" "npm run dev -w @meduza/web"
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @meduza/api && npm run build -w @meduza/web
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run start -w @meduza/api" "npm run start -w @meduza/web"
scripts.test: npm run build:packages && node database/scripts/prepare-test-db.mjs && npm run test -w @meduza/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck -w @meduza/api && npm run typecheck -w @meduza/web
scripts.setup: npm install && npm run db:up && npm run db:seed
scripts.demo: npm run build && npm run start
scripts.e2e: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @meduza/api && cd e2e && npm install --no-audit --no-fund --silent && node run.mjs
scripts.e2e:tour: cd e2e && npm install --no-audit --no-fund --silent && node tour.mjs
